COVID_original.description: COVID-19 PCR-positive vs. negative saliva as in the original study, where the enrolment group is almost completely confounded with the collection site

COVID_NSW_PCR.description: follow-up PCR positive vs. negative on the day of collection, within a single site (NSW); the only COVID-19 comparison free of site confounding

COVID_site_NSW_vs_TPCH.description: COVID-positive subjects from two collection sites (TPCH vs. NSW); an audit comparison whose label is the site, not the disease
